description: Source code for a Recognizer-based decoder in Kubernetes, implementing RecognizingDecoder interface and decoder logic.

classes.name: decoder
classes.description: Implements a multi-decoder that recognizes data using RecognizingDecoder interface and falls back to other decoders.

methods.name: RecognizesData
methods.description: Determines if the data matches any of the decoders, prioritizing RecognizingDecoder implementations.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Attempts to decode data using recognized decoders, with fallback to other decoders if recognition fails.
